name: Alsona
summary: AI sales agents that track 32+ buying signals, score accounts against your ICP and run personalised LinkedIn and email outreach to book calls.
description: AI sales agents that track 32+ buying signals, score accounts against your ICP and run personalised LinkedIn and email outreach to book calls.

pricing.details: 7-day free trial on every plan. Starter 88 €/month (500 high-intent prospects, 2 agents); Pro 133 €/month (2,500 prospects, 8 agents); Ultra 445 €/month (10,000 prospects, unlimited agents). Extra sender 53 €/month.
pricing.label: Premium

features: Buying-signal tracking (hiring, funding, tech changes, reviews, ad spend…)
MCP server and API on Pro
